decisions.text: Kinetic energy was selected as the power source.
The case will be made of rubber.
Selected a dark blue base color with bright primary fruit accents.
Chose a blue backlight for the display.
Buttons will be red with red LEDs.
The flipping mechanism for the screen will be kept.
No flipping mechanism will be used.
The product name is 'The Real Remote'.

notes:
## Meeting Logistics and Setup
- Marketing Expert switched the meeting language to English.
- Marketing Expert and Industrial Designer discussed sharing presentations in the shared folder; Industrial Designer placed the conceptual design there.
- Project Manager noted they are recording all decisions.
- Attendees discussed difficulties using PowerPoint and suggested moving to the meeting room.
## Marketing Trends
- Marketing trends for young public favor fresh, bright colors, fruit/vegetable themes, and spongey materials.
- Key priorities for the remote control are: 1. Fancy look-and-feel (most important), 2. Technological innovation, 3. Ease of use.
## Component Design Discussion
- Industrial Designer presented component options including basic battery, hand dynamo (kneipgatt), and solar cells.
- Solar cells were noted as potentially unusable in low-light areas like Scandinavia.
- Case options include traditional flat hard case, single curved, and double curved (preferred for being daring).
- Preferred case materials include hard plastic, wood, titanium, and rubber (preferred for modern look).
- Interface design discussion includes scroll buttons vs. push buttons (arrow buttons decided on push buttons).
- Advanced chip selected for easier production implementation.
## Energy Source
- Kinetic energy was chosen as the power source because it is long-lasting and fun to use, though it is more expensive to manufacture than batteries.
- Only one energy source can be fitted on the device.
## Case Design
- The case will be made of rubber and double-curved in two dimensions to appeal to a younger audience and be safe to throw.
- The team debated between single and double curvature; single curvature was chosen as a compromise to appeal to a broader public.
## User Interface
- Speech commands will be implemented for both basic and advanced options, matching existing functions.
- Buttons will have individual LED lights that can be customized, and the interface will support sound.
## Ergonomic Design and Screen Mechanism
- Discussed curved shapes and one-handed usability, including a trigger button for scrolling and confirmation.
- Proposed a pop-up screen mechanism where simple functions are visible initially, and advanced options appear when flipped open.
- Discussed mechanical flipping vs. a trigger button; agreed on a solid closing mechanism to protect the LCD screen from scratches.
- Addressed left-handed usability concerns and the cost of designing two versions; decided to choose one ergonomic shape.
## Color Scheme and Display
- Agreed on a dark blue base color with bright primary colors (red, yellow, orange, green) for fruit-like accents.
- Decided on a blue backlight for the display to avoid old-fashioned green or expensive specific color codes.
- Discussed high contrast between background and foreground for visibility and accessibility for colorblind users.
## Additional Features
- Suggested adding flashing standby lights to help users locate the remote control easily.
## Visual Design and Color Scheme
- Background should be bright with colorful objects (yellow, orange, red) on it.
- Buttons should be red to match the LEDs, as green buttons on a green background look cheap and lack contrast.
- Green is considered a trendy color that works well.
- Red and green LEDs are the easiest to discriminate for colorblind users.
- Buttons should be made of see-through plastic with a colored LED behind them to shine.
## Product Shape and Structure
- The device should have a thin middle section for holding with fingers and a thicker upper side.
- The display should be integrated into the bubble structure rather than flipping separately.
- The flipping mechanism is kept to allow adjusting the angle of the screen.
## Smartboard Work Session
- Industrial Designer and User Interface Designer will work on the smartboard for 30 minutes to design look-and-feel.
- They need to draw front, side, and back views, including the screen placement and button layout.
tldr: The team reviewed marketing trends, finalized the product name as 'The Real Remote', and settled on a rubber double-curved case with red buttons and green LEDs, removing the flipping mechanism for safety.
